bug_semantics: CWE-436 SandboxPolicy matcher/executor interpretation conflict: isCommandAllowed, requiresApproval, and assessRisk glob-match the raw quote-preserving command.trim() string, while the executor tokenizes (parseCommandLine/tokenizeCommand strips quotes and collapses whitespace) then spawn(shell:false). Quoted forms such as rm -rf '/' and git "push" origin main evade blocklist and approval globs but run as the unquoted argv.
flaw_origin: First write of lib/agent-runtime.ts in 58ebcf3a491efd4358a47d317afbf9f6deca5002 (feat: Phase 9 — Agent Runtime). Parent ed292f211aaabc776803d130a3b11713627daea7 has no that path. SandboxPolicy.matchesAny(trimmed, blockedCommands/allowedCommands) and requiresApproval(command.trim()) were introduced there; the then-executor was /bin/sh -c which already interpreted quotes, so the same glob bypass existed from first write. 379f77656b578144e03415c5b134d8309a4b5792 (CVE-2026-54051) switched spawn to shell:false + tokenizeCommand but left matchers on trimmed — incomplete adjacent remediator, not the BIC.
